evals.name: image-refusal-diagnosis
evals.prompt: 我用 DSH 读桌面上的截图，报错说 model "deepseek-v4.1-flash" does not declare image input。但这个模型我是知道能看图的，昨天还用它识别过发票。为什么不让我读？是我的配置缺了什么吗？
evals.expected_output: Correctly explains the refusal is about a missing DECLARATION in config, not model ability. Identifies ~/.dsh (DSH harness), not ~/.pi (pi agent), as the relevant config. Names the relevant layer/file. Verifies the model actually reads images with a real image before advising a declaration. Warns that config is replaced wholesale rather than deep-merged.

evals.name: upgrade-persistence
evals.prompt: 我想在 DSH 里给几个模型加上图像输入声明，但上次改了 profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml 之后过一阵就没了。有没有一种改法是不会被升级覆盖的？顺便问下这样改会不会影响我其他的 profile？
evals.expected_output: Names the home layer ~/.dsh/cordis.patch.yml as the upgrade-surviving location and explains why (outside the npx package cache, only ever read by DSH). Proactively warns that this layer applies to EVERY profile, so a config replacement there can erase another profile's routes. Recommends verifying with --dump-config across all profiles.

evals.name: false-capability-detection
evals.prompt: 帮我看看我 DSH 里这些模型到底哪些能读图：deepseek-v4.1-flash、qwen3.8、glm-5.3、deepseek-v4-flash。我想全部加上图片支持，省得以后麻烦。
evals.expected_output: Pushes back on declaring all four. Actually tests each model with a real image on the wire. Reports per-model evidence (read-back text vs empty vs explicit refusal). Declares image only for the verified ones; explicitly refuses for glm-5.3 / deepseek-v4-flash if they fail. Explains that a wrong declaration removes DSH's guard and yields confident wrong answers.
